text.en:
Sets your Base Class Ability cooldown to that of Marksman's Dodge. 

With full Class Abililty energy, enemies you look at within 27 meters become visually marked. Mark up to 3 enemies.

Casting your Class Ability with at least one mark active fires three ~150-180 RPM <solar/>Scorching Golden Gun rounds equally divided across all marked enemies. Lower frame rates can slow the RPM, though animation duration remains the same. 

Each shot deals <pve 354 /> <pvp [21] /> damage and applies 20 <solar/>Scorch (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes). Landing all 3 shots grants <solar/>Cure x1.

Can be activated while in the air, and triggers the effects of your equipped dodge when activated.

Benefits from <solar/>Radiant, which grants the shots <pve 20% /> <pvp [0%] /> increased damage. Pairing Crackshot with <solar/>Acrobat's Dodge always applies the damage bonus.

Crackshot can further scale up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
